1.web: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
1.asv: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me; For my soul taketh refuge in thee: Yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I take refuge, Until these calamities be overpast.

2.web: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.
2.asv: I will cry unto God Most High, Unto God that performeth all things for me.

3.web: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.
3.asv: He will send from heaven, and save me, Whenhe that would swallow me up reproacheth; [Selah God will send forth his lovingkindness and his truth.

4.web: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
4.asv: My soul is among lions; I lie among them that are set on fire, Even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.

5.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
5.asv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Let thy glory be above all the earth.

6.web: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into its midst themselves. Selah.
6.asv: They have prepared a net for my steps; My soul is bowed down: They have digged a pit before me; They are fallen into the midst thereof themselves. [Selah

7.web: My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
7.asv: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing, yea, I will sing praises.

8.web: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, psaltery and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
8.asv: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.

9.web: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
9.asv: I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the peoples: I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

10.web: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.
10.asv: For thy lovingkindness is great unto the heavens, And thy truth unto the skies.

11.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
11.asv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Let thy glory be above all the earth.
